description: This file contains a C# implementation of a mock storage provider class used for testing within the Orleans framework. It includes extension methods for configuring test storage providers, the MockStorageProvider class with state management, command execution, and internal state tracking, as well as related nested classes and enums.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add test storage providers.

classes.name: MockStorageProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of IControllable and IGrainStorage used for testing storage interactions in Orleans.

classes.name: StateForTest
classes.description: A serializable class representing the internal state counts for testing purposes.

classes.name: SetValueArgs
classes.description: A serializable class encapsulating arguments for setting a value in the mock storage.

methods.name: AddTestStorageProvider
methods.description: Extension method to add a test storage provider to the silo builder.

methods.name: GetProviderState
methods.description: Returns the current internal state counts of the mock storage provider.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the mock storage for a specific grain.

methods.name: GetLastState
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored state object.

methods.name: GetLastState<T>
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored state object cast to type T.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider, clearing internal state.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state for a specific grain asynchronously.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the state for a specific grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the state for a specific grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a control command on the storage provider.
